confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and pint anchors follow current aggregated Dublin prices; the cocktail uses a current downtown benchmark. Wine is inferred at roughly 1.15 times a local pint because a dependable restaurant glass price was not available. Accommodation is a broad annual estimate from general knowledge and is especially date-sensitive.
comparable_city_reasoning: Dublin's high tourism demand and expensive Western European capital market inform the food and lodging levels; accommodation anchors are broad traveler-market estimates, not live listing checks.
